item.title: Fogging Schedule for 27th – 31st July, 2020
item.description: The Ministry of Health, Wellness and the Environment wishes to advise the general public that as part of the its mosquito control programme for the adult Aedes Aegypti mosquito, the Insect Vector Control Unit will be conducting fogging operations in the following areas commencing at 5:30 pm daily. Please click for full details.

item.title: Garifuna Conference And School Festival Set For March
item.description: A call to Unity will be the central focus of this year’s Garifuna Conference to be held from 9th - 11th March, 2023. The conference will take place at the National Insurance Services (NIS) Conference Room from 8:00 a.m. daily.

item.title: CED Technology Fair To Promote Digitalization For MSMEs
item.description: Business owners and the general public will next week have another opportunity to familiarize themselves with the organizations that provide products and services that would help them to digitalize their operations.
